generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The newly added method `isPointGeometry` is clear and concise for checking if the geometries array contains a single point geometry. However, the usage of `org.apache.lucene.geo.XYPoint` directly in the method can be improved by using an import statement to avoid fully qualifying the class name. This will make the code cleaner and more readable.

The change from `geometry.type() != ShapeType.POINT` to `isPointGeometry(luceneGeometries) == false` is logical, but it introduces a potential issue if `luceneGeometries` is null or not properly initialized before this check. Ensure that `LuceneGeometriesUtils.toXYGeometry(geometry, t -> {})` always returns a valid non-null array to prevent any NullPointerException.

review_comment: I imagine an edge case where we have a multi-point, but all points are the same, or at least quantize to the same point.
indeed, this requires a bit more work but this is still an improvement.
I see this fix was already in the geo_point case from years ago. So this increases symmetry too.
